text:
Maya: FYI I pulled in the customer's LoRA (merchant-finvoices/loRA-v2) on top of merchant-base and did a quick smoke eval. Perplexity looks fine but totals in generated invoices are off (decimal shift).
Priya: ugh. quick question 12 is this only on quantized runs?
Maya: yes - fp16 baseline matches expected. int8_fast and int8_dynamic both show the problem.
Omar: can you paste the minimal eval config you used?
Maya: here you go:
```
suite: tiny-eval
model: merchant-base+merchant-loRA-v2
quant: int8_dynamic
prompts: ./packs/merchant/invoice-mini-20.jsonl
metrics: [numeric_accuracy, token_rate]
batch: 4
```
Luis: any examples of bad outputs vs good?
Maya: short one:
```
prompt: "Calculate invoice total for items: 250.00, 125.50"
fp16: "Total: $375.50"
int8: "Total: $37.55"
```
Priya: whoa, decimal shifted left by one. Sounds like scaling/normalization somewhere in the adapter path.
Omar: hypothesis: LoRA deltas not being re-scaled correctly when we fold into int8 kernels. We saw similar when adapter multiplier wasn't applied after requant.
Maya: ran variant where quant uses per_channel scales instead of per_tensor and also a run where we disable adapter kernel fusion (`adapter_fuse=false`).
eval-bot: tiny-eval started for 1752003333 at 1752003341
Maya: results: per_channel -> numeric_accuracy=0.94, adapter_fuse=false -> numeric_accuracy=0.96. default int8 -> 0.78. fp16 -> 0.995. latency cost: per_channel +3%, adapter_fuse +6%.
Luis: great signal. So two mitigations: prefer per-channel and avoid fusion for adapter path until we incorporate scale-bias correction.
Priya: action items: 1) add a regression set of 50 synthetic invoice cases into packs/merchant/regression/invoice-decimals.jsonl; 2) update quick-eval pack README to recommend `quant: int8_per_channel` when LO RA blends present; 3) add a runtime flag to fallback to fp16 for customer pinned routes if numeric_accuracy < 0.9.
Omar: I'll draft a small shim in the quant conversion step that applies adapter scale compensation when folding. That should allow us to re-enable fusion later.
Maya: pushed a branch `merchant/quant-fixes` with the regression pack and README note. PR: https://git.redwood/merchant/merge/42
Priya: can you also add a short unit prompt set that specifically targets decimal-placement edgecases (commas, leading zeros, different locales)?
Maya: adding locale cases now. ETA 10m.
eval-bot: tiny-eval summary for 1752003333 at 1752003387: fp16 baseline numeric_accuracy=0.995; int8 default=0.779; int8_per_channel=0.941; int8_adapter_no_fuse=0.963; regression alerts fired for default int8.
Luis: OK. once CI on merchant/quant-fixes is green we'll flip the quick-eval default for merchant customer packs and create an Optimize alert linking the regression set.
Priya: tagging product: @product-team decision: default quant behavior for merchant customer quickpacks until we have the adapter-scale shim.
Maya: thanks team. keeping thread open for follow-ups, but closing after product OK and PR merge.
